description: COLUMBIANA — Monica Robb Blasdel of Columbiana has announced her intention to run for election as state representative in the 79th district. She plans to file her petitions with the Board of Election prior to the February deadline.

title: Morning Journal: Monica Robb Blasdel to Run for State Representative — Monica Robb Blasdel for State Representative
